INSPECTION PROCEDURE 3:Some door windows do not or close using the power window sub 
switch (on passenger doors).(However,they open or close when the power window main switch is 
used.)
CIRCUIT OPERATION
• Power is supplied to the power window sub-
switch from the power window relay.
TECHNICAL DESCRIPTION (COMMENT)
• The cause may be a malfunction of the power 
window sub-switch power supply circuit.
TROUBLESHOOTING HINTS
• Malfunction of the power window sub-switch 
<RH>
• Damaged harness wires or connectors
